Yes, exactly. Since your original order had a plant in it, the replacement will ship on a plant day—**Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday only**.

So once the courier investigation wraps up (up to **5 business days**) and we confirm it's lost, we'll get your replacement plant out on the next available plant shipping day after that.

To get started, please send your **order number** (it's in LF- format with six digits). Please don't send any card details.

Would you also like me to escalate the Express shipping question to a Support Lead?
